csv_fallback: Existing converted CSVs are compared only for overlay histories whose native T binaries differ outside the validated timestamp field. The audit verifies each conversion receipt against its native source, TITLES, converter output file, and run receipt; it does not launch the solver or converter.
method: Direct comparison of full retained native T histories; only the validated 24-byte ASCII wall-clock field at byte offset 96 is normalized. No solver or converter is executed.

paper07_material_history_report.endpoint_sampling_semantics: The material collector labels endpoint frames exact when final T01 time is within 1.1e-6 s of requested end. All paired times are equal between providers; they are not bitwise equal to their requested end-time values.

runtime_timing_diagnostic.basis: Recorded process elapsed_s in the native run receipts for these four short coupon engine processes; exploratory only.

summary.full_history_difference_interpretation: Per-field maxima and scales are retained; do not interpret cross-unit aggregate absolute error or near-zero-channel ratios as a single pass threshold.
